Website & registration metrics

Website measurement starts with this dashboard update; earlier traffic is not available. Counts include only browsers that allow website analytics. Visitors are estimates, not identified people; different devices, cleared storage, and the 30-day identifier reset can count someone again. Visits count a browser tab session, renewed on a page load after 30 minutes. The iPhone app and admin page are excluded. Registrations include verified accounts from the website and app and exclude the owner account. These different populations should not be used to calculate a conversion rate.

Removal requests

Requests are listed oldest first. Review notes are visible to the requesting customer. Close a request only with an accurate explanation of the outcome. Do not describe retained data as deleted.

Support inbox

New messages from the updated app appear here, oldest first. Earlier Web3Forms messages remain in your email inbox. Customer updates appear in the app when the customer signs in with the email used for their message.

Service health

Counts are best-effort reports from the updated app, not confirmed email-delivery failures or a complete outage monitor. Zero reports does not guarantee service availability. Old app versions and offline failures may not report. Provider incidents below may affect other regions or projects.
